* \[[`2360d3860e`](https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/2360d3860e)] - **(SEMVER-MINOR)** **dns**: coalesce identical concurrent lookup() requests (Orgad Shaneh) [#62599](https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/62599)
* \[[`dc4aa75983`](https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/dc4aa75983)] - **doc**: add efekrskl to collaborators (Efe Karasakal) [#67376](https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/67376)

* \[[`8ffcb3ee55`](https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/8ffcb3ee55)] - **(SEMVER-MINOR)** **sea**: generate a compile cache for the VFS modules (Matteo Collina) [#66768](https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/66768)
